budget_covers_required_set.rule: a bounded row's budget covers its required set when required_set_tokens <= kept_slots, where kept_slots is the measured retained width of the bounded arm (not the nominal budget) and required_set_tokens is the mean tokens per item statement times the number of items the answer needs
